note: Adapted from the English species-level description in Bacchus (1997); the alate is recorded as Unknown in the original, so only the soldier section is taken; the measurement table was garbled by OCR, so no measurements are cited.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule and labrum yellow to pale orange; mandibles brown with yellow bases; antennae pale yellow to yellow, brownish on both sides, segment 1 darker; postmentum concolorous with the head and genae, brownish on both sides; thoracic nota, body and legs pale yellow. Head capsule long-oval, posterior margin slightly rounded; head surface with numerous setae, regularly and symmetrically arranged; labrum ligulate, with 3—4 pairs of setae on the anterior third, the apical pair long, the posterior pairs less than half as long as the long pair. Mandible apex slightly incurved, curvature 0.03—0.04 mm. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest, slightly shorter than segment 4, segments 1 and 2 subequal. Postmentum moderately long, about 1.5 times its width. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin with a moderately deep V-shaped notch, posterior margin straight or slightly concave. Fore tibia slightly inflated, spurs 3, the dorsal spur almost as long as the outer ventral spur.
